title: 海棠形喷水池 Haitangxing penshui chi
subtitle: Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace, assumed: sizes from the texts and the ruin polygons, position from the plan or the ruin. Not a reading of the 1786 engravings yet.

evidence.title: Plate II: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, south front (by content)
evidence.excerpt_other: Sur le sol de cette seconde terrasse sont placées à droite et à gauche deux galeries en hémicycle, lesquelles ne s'élèvent que jusqu'au niveau de la première terrasse.
evidence.summary: Round stair with a double ramp and a niche with a throne; a basin with vases and animals, birds and quadrupeds spouting; a dolphin in the centre; octagonal pavilions at the ends of the galleries; on the left a triumphal arch with a European dial; a three-arch bridge. Delatour's Plate II matches Malone's Engraving 1.

evidence.title: Engraving 1: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, south front
evidence.excerpt_other: A three-story building in the center was joined by curved galleries to two two-storied towers at the southeast and southwest of the main building.
evidence.summary: Curved stairs from the second floor down to a pool with several fountains between galleries and towers; a lake with a balustrade in front. Capitals mix Corinthian and Ionic (p.143).
